note: Hand-written, first draft 2026-11-17, for the Russian pilot. A broad transcription that shows what a learner cannot read off the spelling: vowel reduction, palatalization, devoicing.
conventions: Standard Russian as spoken in Moscow. Palatalization is written with ʲ after the consonant (нет is /ˈnʲet/). Unstressed vowels are written reduced: о and а are ɐ in the syllable before the stress and at the start of a word and ə elsewhere (молоко is /mə.lɐ.ˈko/); е and я after a soft consonant are ɪ (река is /rʲɪ.ˈka/); unstressed у and и keep u and i. ы is ɨ. A voiced consonant is written voiceless at the end of a word and before a voiceless one (хлеб is /ˈxlʲep/, водка is /ˈvot.kə/). ш and ж are ʂ and ʐ, щ is ɕː, ч is tɕ, ц is ts, hard л is l. A letter that is not said is not written, and a letter said as another is written as it is said (солнце is /ˈson.tsə/, что is /ˈʂto/, его is /jɪ.ˈvo/).
